The '''Arcade''' was the name given to the main hall of the [[Gymnasium]] on [[Rabaan]]. An ancient wooden gate served as the Arcade's entrance, and the hall itself contained long stone columns.<ref name="AJ9">{{JournalCite|9|Combat Moon (short story)}}</ref>
